message.content:
具有多個細胞核的細胞通常被稱為「多核細胞」或「同步體（syncytia）」。這些細胞在不同組織中有各自的功能，例如：

| 細胞類型 | 位置 | 功能 |
|----------|------|------|
| 骨骼肌纖維 | 肌肉 | 收縮運動 |
| 骨吸收細胞（Osteoclast） | 骨骼 | 分解骨質 |
| 同步體胎盤細胞（Syncytiotrophoblast） | 胎盤 | 促進營養交換與激素分泌 |

如果你想了解特定類型的多核細胞，請告訴我！

In biology, multinucleated cells include skeletal muscle fibers (myocytes), osteoclasts, syncytiotrophoblasts, some fungi, etc. But likely they refer to "multinucleated giant cells" or "syncytia". The question: "What is the name of the type of cell that has multiple nuclei?" The answer: "Multinucleated cells are called syncytia." Or "multinucleated giant cells." So we can respond in Chinese: "具有多個細胞核的細胞稱為多核細胞或同步體(syncytia)".
